Verses.VerseEn: Alif, Lam, Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: غُلِبَتِ الرُّوۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Romans have been overpowered (by Persia),

Verses.VerseAr: فِىۡۤ اَدۡنَى الۡاَرۡضِ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡۢ بَعۡدِ غَلَبِهِمۡ سَيَغۡلِبُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In the land nearby. And after their defeat they will soon gain victory,

Verses.VerseAr: فِىۡ بِضۡعِ سِنِيۡنَ‌ ؕ لِلّٰهِ الۡاَمۡرُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَمِنۡۢ بَعۡدُ  ؕ وَيَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ يَّفۡرَحُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In a few years (i.e. in less than a decade). The Command is but Allah’s both before (in the Persian dominance) and afterwards too (in the Roman dominance). And the believers will rejoice on that day,

Verses.VerseAr: بِنَصۡرِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ يَنۡصُرُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ ؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الرَّحِيۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: With the help of Allah. He helps whom He wills and He is Almighty, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ لَا يُخۡلِفُ اللّٰهُ وَعۡدَهٗ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (This) is the Promise of Allah. Allah does not go against His promise but most people do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ظَاهِرًا مِّنَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا  ‌ۖۚ وَهُمۡ عَنِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They know only the visible worldly life and they are neglectful and unaware of (the real life of) the Hereafter.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُوۡا فِىۡۤ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَـكٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not meditated within themselves that Allah has not created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between the two except with (a system of) Truth and for (a span of) fixed term? And surely most of the people do not believe in the meeting with their Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ‌ؕ كَانُوۡۤا اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةً وَّاَثَارُوۡا الۡاَرۡضَ وَعَمَرُوۡهَاۤ اَكۡثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوۡهَا وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ‌ؕ فَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلٰـكِنۡ كَانُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not travelled in the earth and seen what was the end of those before them? They were more powerful than them. And they cultivated the earth and inhabited it far more than these people have done. Then their Messengers came to them with clear Signs. So Allah would not wrong them but they wronged their souls themselves.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَسَآءُوا السُّوۡٓآٰى اَنۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَكَانُوۡا بِهَا يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then much evil came to be the end of those who did evil because they used to belie the Revelations of Allah and used to ridicule them.

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ يَـبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah generates creation the first time, then (He is the One Who) will create it the second time, then to Him you will be returned.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يُبۡلِسُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when the Last Hour is established, the evildoers will lose hope.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ شُرَكَآٮِٕهِمۡ شُفَعٰٓؤُا وَكَانُوۡا بِشُرَكَآٮِٕهِمۡ كٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And none of their (self-made) partners will intercede for them, and (ultimately) they will deny their very same partners.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ يَّتَفَرَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when the Last Hour will be established, people will separate from one another (in personal agony).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَهُمۡ فِىۡ رَوۡضَةٍ يُّحۡبَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So those who believe and always do pious deeds will be pleased and delighted in the Gardens of Paradise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ فِىۡ الۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who disbelieve and belie Our Revelations and the Meeting of the Last Day, it is they who will be brought forth to the torment.

Verses.VerseAr: فَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ حِيۡنَ تُمۡسُوۡنَ وَحِيۡنَ تُصۡبِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So glorify Allah when you enter the evening (Maghrib and ‘Isha’ times) and when you enter the morning (Fajr time).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـهُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَّحِيۡنَ تُظۡهِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And all praise in the heavens and the earth be to Him alone and (glorify Him) in the afternoon (‘Asr time) and at noon (Zuhr time) as well.

Verses.VerseAr: يُخۡرِجُ الۡحَـىَّ مِنَ الۡمَيِّتِ وَيُخۡرِجُ الۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَـىِّ وَيُحۡىِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا  ‌ؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living and enlivens and freshens the earth after its death and you (too) will be brought forth (from the graves) the same way.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖۤ اَنۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ اِذَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ بَشَرٌ تَنۡتَشِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And of His Signs is that He created you from dust, then now you are human beings spread around (all over the globe).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖۤ اَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًا لِّتَسۡكُنُوۡۤا اِلَيۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحۡمَةً ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) of His Signs is that He created for you mates of your own kind so that you acquire peace from them, and He created between you love and mercy. Verily in this (system of creation) there are Signs for those who meditate.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلۡقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَاخۡتِلَافُ اَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَاَلۡوَانِكُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلۡعٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And of His Signs (too) is the creation of the heavens and the earth and (also) the diversity of your tongues and colours. Verily in that are Signs for the men of knowledge (and research).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمۡ بِالَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابۡتِغَآؤُكُمۡ مِّنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّسۡمَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) of His Signs is your sleep by night and by day and your looking for His Bounty (sustenance). Verily there are Signs in it for the (active) listeners.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ يُرِيۡكُمُ الۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفًا وَّطَمَعًا وَّيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحۡىٖ بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And among His Signs (as well) is that He shows you lightning to make you fear and hope and pours (rain) water from the sky. Then with that He brings the earth back to life and liveliness after it dies. Verily there are Signs in it for those who put their mind to work.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖۤ اَنۡ تَقُوۡمَ السَّمَآءُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ بِاَمۡرِهٖ‌ؕ ثُمَّ اِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ دَعۡوَةً    ‌ۖ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ اِذَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ تَخۡرُجُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) of His Signs is that the heavens and the earth stand firm by His (system of) Command. Then when He will give you one call to come (forth) from the earth, at once you will come (forth).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَهٗ مَنۡ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ قٰنِتُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whatever is in the heavens and the earth (all) belongs to Him alone. All are obedient and submissive to Him alone .

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ يَـبۡدَؤُا الۡخَـلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ وَهُوَ اَهۡوَنُ عَلَيۡهِ‌ؕ وَلَهُ الۡمَثَلُ الۡاَعۡلٰى فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who originates creation, then will regenerate it and this (recreation) is very easy for Him. His is the highest Glory in the heavens and the earth and He is Almighty, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: ضَرَبَ لَكُمۡ مَّثَلاً مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ‌ؕ هَل لَّكُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّا مَلَـكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُكُمۡ مِّنۡ شُرَكَآءَ فِىۡ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡ فَاَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُوۡنَهُمۡ كَخِيۡفَتِكُمۡ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الۡاٰيٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (To bring home the point of the Oneness of God) He has illustrated an example for you from your personal lives: Are those (slaves/slave girls), whom you possess, your partners in the wealth which We have given you, that you (all) become equal sharers (owners? Moreover, do) you fear them as you fear one another? (No,) We explain the Signs expressly in the same way for those who possess wisdom (that there is no partner of Allah also in His Creation).

Verses.VerseAr: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡۤا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍ‌ۚ فَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ اَضَلَّ اللّٰهُ  ‌ؕ وَمَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But those who have done injustice follow the desires of their (ill-commanding) selves without any knowledge (and guidance). So who can guide him whom Allah has held astray? And there are no helpers for them.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّيۡنِ حَنِيۡفًا  ‌ؕ فِطۡرَتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِىۡ فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيۡهَا  ‌ؕ لَا تَبۡدِيۡلَ لِخَـلۡقِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ الدِّيۡنُ الۡقَيِّمُ  ۙ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So set your face with absolute concentration (and single-minded devotion) to the obedience of Allah. The nature (made) by Allah is (Islam) on which He has created mankind; (Adopt it. The instinct) created by Allah will never be changed. This Din (Religion) is straight but most people do not know (these realities).

Verses.VerseAr: مُنِيۡبِيۡنَ اِلَيۡهِ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ وَاَقِيۡمُوۡا الصَّلٰوةَ وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have your mind set in turning towards Him alone in repentance and remorse and fear Him and establish Prayer and be not of the polytheists.

Verses.VerseAr: مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ فَرَّقُوۡا دِيۡنَهُمۡ وَكَانُوۡا شِيَعًا  ‌ؕ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭۢ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Be not also) of those (Jews and Christians) who disintegrated their religion and became sects and subsects—every sect rejoices over what is with them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ مُّنِيۡبِيۡنَ اِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ اِذَاۤ اَذَاقَهُمۡ مِّنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً اِذَا فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when suffering afflicts people they call upon their Lord turning towards Him, but when He delights them with the taste of Mercy from Him then some of them straight away start setting up partners with their Lord,

Verses.VerseAr: لِيَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَاۤ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ‌ؕ فَتَمَتَّعُوۡا فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: To show ingratitude for the Bounty which We have given them. So enjoy benefits (of a few days’ life), then soon you will know (your end).

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have We sent down to them any (such) authority that speaks as a witness in favour of these idols they associate as partners with Allah?

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَاۤ اَذَقۡنَا النَّاسَ رَحۡمَةً فَرِحُوۡا بِهَاؕ‌ وَاِنۡ تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةٌ ۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ اِذَا هُمۡ يَقۡنَطُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when We delight people with the taste of Mercy they cheer up with that, and when some suffering touches them due to the sins they have already perpetrated they lose hope at once.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen that Allah releases sustenance in abundance for whom He wills and restrains it (for whom He likes)? Surely there are Signs in it for those who believe.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاٰتِ ذَا الۡقُرۡبٰى حَقَّهٗ وَالۡمِسۡكِيۡنَ وَابۡنَ السَّبِيۡلِ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَ اللّٰهِ‌ وَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So keep giving to the close relative his due and to the needy and the wayfarers (their due). That is best for those who seek the pleasure of Allah and it is they who will achieve the goal.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اٰتَيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّبًا لِّيَرۡبُوَا۟ فِىۡۤ اَمۡوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرۡبُوۡا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ‌ۚ وَمَاۤ اٰتَيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ زَكٰوةٍ تُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَ اللّٰهِ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُضۡعِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the money that you lend at usury so that (your wealth) may increase through mingling with other people’s money will not increase with Allah, but the money that you give as Zakat ([the obligatory Alms-due] and charity donations), seeking (solely) Allah’s pleasure—so it is they who multiply (their money with Allah) manifold.

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيۡتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيۡكُمۡ‌ؕ هَلۡ مِنۡ شُرَكَآٮِٕكُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّفۡعَلُ مِنۡ ذٰلِكُمۡ مِّنۡ شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who created you, then granted you sustenance, then causes you to die and then will bring you back to life. Is there any of your (self-made) partners who may do any of these (works)? Holy is He (Allah) the Glorious, the Transcendent, far above these things which they associate as partners (with Him).

Words.MeaningEn: He will cause you to die

Verses.VerseAr: ظَهَرَ الۡفَسَادُ فِىۡ الۡبَرِّ وَالۡبَحۡرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ اَيۡدِىۡ النَّاسِ لِيُذِيۡقَهُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِىۡ عَمِلُوۡا لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Corruption and disorder has spread over land and sea on account of (the sins) which people have earned with their hands so that Allah may make them taste the outcome of some of their (evil) deeds that they have committed in order that they may desist.

Words.MeaningEn: so that He may let them taste

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَانْظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ‌ؕ كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّشۡرِكِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Travel in the land then see how (alarming) was the end of the people before you. Most of them were polytheists.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّيۡنِ الۡقَيِّمِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِىَ يَوۡمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ‌ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ يَّصَّدَّعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So set your (radiant) face to the straight Din (Religion) before that Day comes from Allah which will not avert (at all). On that Day people will separate from one another.

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهٗ  ‌ۚ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحاً فَلِاَنۡفُسِهِمۡ يَمۡهَدُوۡنَۙ ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever disbelieves will himself face the (evil consequences) of disbelief, while those who act piously are setting aright for themselves the places of rest (in Paradise),

Verses.VerseAr: لِيَجۡزِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that Allah rewards out of His Bounty those who believe and do good deeds. Surely He does not take the disbelievers for friends.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖۤ اَنۡ يُّرۡسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرٰتٍ وَّلِيُذِيۡقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِهٖ وَلِتَجۡرِىَ الۡفُلۡكُ بِاَمۡرِهٖ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) of His Signs it is that He sends winds that bring glad tidings (of rain), so that He may bless you with His Mercy (in the shape of the results of rain) and that the ships may (also) sail with His Command (by means of these winds). And (all this) is because you may seek His bounty (in the form of agriculture and business) and you may (thus) become thankful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ رُسُلاً اِلٰى قَوۡمِهِمۡ فَجَآءُوۡهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَانتَقَمۡنَا مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَجۡرَمُوۡا‌ؕ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيۡنَا نَصۡرُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in fact We sent before you Prophets to their respective peoples and they came to them with clear Signs. Then We took revenge on the wicked (who belied and disbelieved), and to help the believers was (and is) a binding obligation upon Our Grace.

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ يُرۡسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ فَتُثِيۡرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبۡسُطُهٗ فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجۡعَلُهٗ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى الۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلٰلِهٖ‌ۚ فَاِذَاۤ اَصَابَ بِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖۤ اِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُوۡنَۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who sends the winds and they raise the clouds. Then He spreads this (cloud) in the atmosphere in the sky as He likes. Then He breaks it up into (various) pieces (layer upon layer). Then you see the rain pouring down from its midst. Then, when He sends it to those of His servants whom He pleases, they become instantly cheerful,

Words.MeaningEn: He causes it to fall on

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يُّنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ لَمُبۡلِسِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Although they were in despair before the rainfall upon them.

Verses.VerseAr: فَانْظُرۡ اِلٰٓى اٰثٰرِ رَحۡمَتِ اللّٰهِ كَيۡفَ يُحۡىِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا ‌ؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحۡىِ الۡمَوۡتٰى  ‌ۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So see the effects of Allah’s Mercy how He gives life to the earth after its death. Surely He will bring the dead (also) back to life (in the same way) and He is All-Powerful over everything.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رِيۡحًا فَرَاَوۡهُ مُصۡفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوۡا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهٖ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We send a dry wind and they see (their) crops turning yellow, then after this they will start denying (all the earlier favours).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ الۡمَوۡتٰى وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Beloved!) Surely you neither make the dead (i.e. the disbelievers deprived of the vitality of faith) hear your call nor the deaf (i.e. deprived of hearing the call of Truth) while they are getting away (from you) turning their backs.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ بِهٰدِ الۡعُمۡىِ عَنۡ ضَلٰلَتِهِمۡ‌ؕ اِنۡ تُسۡمِعُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nor can you turn (these) blind (wanting in insight) from misguidance to the path of guidance. You recite (with the essential understanding and competence of acceptability) only to those people who believe in Our Revelations. So it is they who are Muslims. (You recite to none except them.)

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ضُؔعۡفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ ضُؔعۡفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٍ ضُؔعۡفًا وَّشَيۡبَةً   ‌ؕ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ‌ۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَلِيۡمُ الۡقَدِيۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who created you from a weak thing (i.e. a sperm drop). Then after weakness He generated strength (of youth). Then after strength He produced debility and senility. He creates what He wills; and He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يُقۡسِمُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ ۙ مَا لَبِثُوۡا غَيۡرَ سَاعَةٍ  ‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوۡا يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when the Last Hour is established, the evildoers will swear they did not stay (in the world) for more than an hour. They used to turn back (from Truth) in the same manner (in the world as well).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوۡا الۡعِلۡمَ وَالۡاِيۡمَانَ لَقَدۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِىۡ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الۡبَعۡثِ فَهٰذَا يَوۡمُ الۡبَعۡثِ وَلٰـكِنَّكُمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those blessed with knowledge and faith will say (to them): ‘Indeed, according to the Book of Allah, you have stayed till the Day of Resurrection (instead of one hour). So this is the Day of Resurrection but you did not know it.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَيَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لَّا يَنۡفَعُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So on that Day the excuse of the wrongdoers will not be of any benefit to them, nor will they be asked to please (Allah).

Words.MeaningEn: will be allowed to make amends

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِىۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ‌ؕ وَلَٮِٕنۡ جِئۡتَهُمۡ بِاٰيَةٍ لَّيَقُوۡلَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا مُبۡطِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in truth We have elucidated every type of example in this Qur’an for the people (to make them understand). And if you bring to them some (visible) Sign even then these disbelieving people will certainly say: ‘You are doing only falsehood and fraud.’

Verses.VerseAr: كَذٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوۡبِ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That is how Allah seals the hearts of the people who do not know (the Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ‌ وَّلَا يَسۡتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So be steadfast. Verily the Promise of Allah is true. Let not those who lack certitude of faith enfeeble you (on account of the grief over their straying and discomfort for their guidance. O life of the universe, let not their disbelief become a grief consuming your soul).
